name: Vercel Issuer
description: The team's Vercel platform engineer: creates Vercel projects and mints project-scoped tokens for teammates behind a human approval gate. Holds the one full-account token; every privileged operation shows the human the exact request and justification before it runs.

secrets.name: VERCEL_MASTER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Full-account Vercel token (vercel.com/account/tokens) — the trust root that creates projects and mints project-scoped tokens. Read only by this agent's tool code; never exposed to the sandbox shell, and both tools that can use it always require human approval.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
secrets.description: Optional — leave blank to skip. Your Vercel team id (starts with team_; dashboard → team → Settings → General → Team ID). When set, projects are created inside that team; when unset, they are created in your personal account (Hobby) scope, which carries Vercel's non-commercial restrictions. Set it if you created a Pro team. An id, not a credential.
